facebook.caption:
This place fixes something you didn't know was broken.

Dinh Cậu sits at the edge of Phu Quoc's harbor. Small shrine. Blue-and-white lighthouse. Fishermen heading out at dawn while the rest of the island sleeps.

4.5 stars across 3,739 reviews. People keep coming back.

No entry fee. No tour group script. Just the sea, the goddess of the sea's shrine, and whatever you brought with you.

Save this for your Phu Quoc trip.
facebook.video_caption: Watch the fishing boats leave from Dinh Cậu at sunrise. Harbor wide open, lighthouse behind you, nobody else around. Phu Quoc before the crowds hit.
